topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I thought the night would burst with laughter and light, a circle of faces aglow with joy, the air buzzing with secret kept and surprise unleashed. The planning, the whispers, the careful steps to arrange something special—to see the sparkle in your eyes, the leap of your heart when the door opened to a room alight with friends and flickering candles. But tonight, the wind whispers differently, carries a different story. I hold close the hope, the warmth of the intention, even as the evening changes course. There's always tomorrow, and the next day, and the days that stretch ahead, filled with chances to fill the air with happiness again. Tonight, I keep the flame small and steady, a quiet glow waiting for the right moment to shine.
